pages.quiz:
MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

4. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31
   C. 37
   D. 31.6

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 45
   C. 18
   D. 30

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 33
   C. 28
   D. 14

7. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 6
   C. 7
   D. 36

8. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

9. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 25
   D. 1

10. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 0.025
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.205

11. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 25
   D. 19.7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
